arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ كهيعص
transliteration: KafhayaAAaynsad
translation: Kaf. Ha. Ya. A'in. Sad

arabic: ذِكرُ رَحمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبدَهُ زَكَرِيّا
transliteration: Thikru rahmati rabbika AAabdahu zakariyya
translation: A mention of the mercy of thy Lord unto His servant Zachariah

arabic: إِذ نادىٰ رَبَّهُ نِداءً خَفِيًّا
transliteration: Ith nada rabbahu nidaan khafiyyan
translation: When he cried unto his Lord a cry in secret

arabic: قالَ رَبِّ إِنّى وَهَنَ العَظمُ مِنّى وَاشتَعَلَ الرَّأسُ شَيبًا وَلَم أَكُن بِدُعائِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا
transliteration: Qala rabbi innee wahana alAAathmu minnee waishtaAAala alrrasu shayban walam akun biduAAaika rabbi shaqiyyan
translation: Saying: My Lord! Lo! the bones of me wax feeble and my head is shining with grey hair, and I have never been unblest in prayer to Thee, my Lord

arabic: وَإِنّى خِفتُ المَوٰلِىَ مِن وَراءى وَكانَتِ امرَأَتى عاقِرًا فَهَب لى مِن لَدُنكَ وَلِيًّا
transliteration: Wainnee khiftu almawaliya min waraee wakanati imraatee AAaqiran fahab lee min ladunka waliyyan
translation: Lo! I fear my kinsfolk after me, since my wife is barren. Oh, give me from Thy presence a successor

arabic: يَرِثُنى وَيَرِثُ مِن ءالِ يَعقوبَ وَاجعَلهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّا
transliteration: Yarithunee wayarithu min ali yaAAqooba waijAAalhu rabbi radiyyan
translation: Who shall inherit of me and inherit (also) of the house of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, acceptable (unto Thee)

arabic: يٰزَكَرِيّا إِنّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلٰمٍ اسمُهُ يَحيىٰ لَم نَجعَل لَهُ مِن قَبلُ سَمِيًّا
transliteration: Ya zakariyya inna nubashshiruka bighulamin ismuhu yahya lam najAAal lahu min qablu samiyyan
translation: (It was said unto him): O Zachariah! Lo! We bring thee tidings of a son whose name is John; we have given the same name to none before (him)

arabic: قالَ رَبِّ أَنّىٰ يَكونُ لى غُلٰمٌ وَكانَتِ امرَأَتى عاقِرًا وَقَد بَلَغتُ مِنَ الكِبَرِ عِتِيًّا
transliteration: Qala rabbi anna yakoonu lee ghulamun wakanati imraatee AAaqiran waqad balaghtu mina alkibari AAitiyyan
translation: He said: My Lord! How can I have a son when my wife is barren and I have reached infirm old age

arabic: قالَ كَذٰلِكَ قالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌ وَقَد خَلَقتُكَ مِن قَبلُ وَلَم تَكُ شَيـًٔا
transliteration: Qala kathalika qala rabbuka huwa AAalayya hayyinun waqad khalaqtuka min qablu walam taku shayan
translation: He said: So (it will be). Thy Lord saith: It is easy for Me, even as I created thee before, when thou wast naught

arabic: قالَ رَبِّ اجعَل لى ءايَةً قالَ ءايَتُكَ أَلّا تُكَلِّمَ النّاسَ ثَلٰثَ لَيالٍ سَوِيًّا
transliteration: Qala rabbi ijAAal lee ayatan qala ayatuka alla tukallima alnnasa thalatha layalin sawiyyan
translation: He said: My Lord! Appoint for me some token. He said: Thy token is that thou, with no bodily defect, shalt not speak unto mankind three nights

arabic: فَخَرَجَ عَلىٰ قَومِهِ مِنَ المِحرابِ فَأَوحىٰ إِلَيهِم أَن سَبِّحوا بُكرَةً وَعَشِيًّا
transliteration: Fakharaja AAala qawmihi mina almihrabi faawha ilayhim an sabbihoo bukratan waAAashiyyan
translation: Then he came forth unto his people from the sanctuary, and signified to them: Glorify your Lord at break of day and fall of night

arabic: يٰيَحيىٰ خُذِ الكِتٰبَ بِقُوَّةٍ وَءاتَينٰهُ الحُكمَ صَبِيًّا
transliteration: Ya yahya khuthi alkitaba biquwwatin waataynahu alhukma sabiyyan
translation: (And it was said unto his son): O John! Hold fast the Scripture. And we gave him wisdom when a child

arabic: وَحَنانًا مِن لَدُنّا وَزَكوٰةً وَكانَ تَقِيًّا
transliteration: Wahananan min ladunna wazakatan wakana taqiyyan
translation: And compassion from Our presence, and purity; and he was devout

arabic: وَبَرًّا بِوٰلِدَيهِ وَلَم يَكُن جَبّارًا عَصِيًّا
transliteration: Wabarran biwalidayhi walam yakun jabbaran AAasiyyan
translation: And dutiful toward his parents. And he was not arrogant, rebellious

arabic: وَسَلٰمٌ عَلَيهِ يَومَ وُلِدَ وَيَومَ يَموتُ وَيَومَ يُبعَثُ حَيًّا
transliteration: Wasalamun AAalayhi yawma wulida wayawma yamootu wayawma yubAAathu hayyan
translation: Peace on him the day he was born, and the day he dieth and the day he shall be raised alive

arabic: وَاذكُر فِى الكِتٰبِ مَريَمَ إِذِ انتَبَذَت مِن أَهلِها مَكانًا شَرقِيًّا
transliteration: Waothkur fee alkitabi maryama ithi intabathat min ahliha makanan sharqiyyan
translation: And make mention of Mary in the Scripture, when she had withdrawn from her people to a chamber looking East

arabic: فَاتَّخَذَت مِن دونِهِم حِجابًا فَأَرسَلنا إِلَيها روحَنا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَها بَشَرًا سَوِيًّا
transliteration: Faittakhathat min doonihim hijaban faarsalna ilayha roohana fatamaththala laha basharan sawiyyan
translation: And had chosen seclusion from them. Then We sent unto her Our Spirit and it assumed for her the likeness of a perfect man

arabic: قالَت إِنّى أَعوذُ بِالرَّحمٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيًّا
transliteration: Qalat innee aAAoothu bialrrahmani minka in kunta taqiyyan
translation: She said: Lo! I seek refuge in the Beneficent One from thee, if thou art Allah-fearing

arabic: قالَ إِنَّما أَنا۠ رَسولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلٰمًا زَكِيًّا
transliteration: Qala innama ana rasoolu rabbiki liahaba laki ghulaman zakiyyan
translation: He said: I am only a messenger of thy Lord, that I may bestow on thee a faultless son

arabic: قالَت أَنّىٰ يَكونُ لى غُلٰمٌ وَلَم يَمسَسنى بَشَرٌ وَلَم أَكُ بَغِيًّا
transliteration: Qalat anna yakoonu lee ghulamun walam yamsasnee basharun walam aku baghiyyan
translation: She said: How can I have a son when no mortal hath touched me, neither have I been unchaste

arabic: قالَ كَذٰلِكِ قالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌ وَلِنَجعَلَهُ ءايَةً لِلنّاسِ وَرَحمَةً مِنّا وَكانَ أَمرًا مَقضِيًّا
transliteration: Qala kathaliki qala rabbuki huwa AAalayya hayyinun walinajAAalahu ayatan lilnnasi warahmatan minna wakana amran maqdiyyan
translation: He said: So (it will be). Thy Lord saith: It is easy for Me. And (it will be) that We may make of him a revelation for mankind and a mercy from Us, and it is a thing ordained

arabic: فَحَمَلَتهُ فَانتَبَذَت بِهِ مَكانًا قَصِيًّا
transliteration: Fahamalathu faintabathat bihi makanan qasiyyan
translation: And she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a far place

arabic: فَأَجاءَهَا المَخاضُ إِلىٰ جِذعِ النَّخلَةِ قالَت يٰلَيتَنى مِتُّ قَبلَ هٰذا وَكُنتُ نَسيًا مَنسِيًّا
transliteration: Faajaaha almakhadu ila jithAAi alnnakhlati qalat ya laytanee mittu qabla hatha wakuntu nasyan mansiyyan
translation: And the pangs of childbirth drove her unto the trunk of the palm-tree. She said: Oh, would that I had died ere this and had become a thing of naught, forgotten

arabic: فَنادىٰها مِن تَحتِها أَلّا تَحزَنى قَد جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحتَكِ سَرِيًّا
transliteration: Fanadaha min tahtiha alla tahzanee qad jaAAala rabbuki tahtaki sariyyan
translation: Then (one) cried unto her from below her, saying: Grieve not! Thy Lord hath placed a rivulet beneath thee

arabic: وَهُزّى إِلَيكِ بِجِذعِ النَّخلَةِ تُسٰقِط عَلَيكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا
transliteration: Wahuzzee ilayki bijithAAi alnnakhlati tusaqit AAalayki rutaban janiyyan
translation: And shake the trunk of the palm-tree toward thee, thou wilt cause ripe dates to fall upon thee

arabic: فَكُلى وَاشرَبى وَقَرّى عَينًا فَإِمّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ البَشَرِ أَحَدًا فَقولى إِنّى نَذَرتُ لِلرَّحمٰنِ صَومًا فَلَن أُكَلِّمَ اليَومَ إِنسِيًّا
transliteration: Fakulee waishrabee waqarree AAaynan faimma tarayinna mina albashari ahadan faqoolee innee nathartu lilrrahmani sawman falan okallima alyawma insiyyan
translation: So eat and drink and be consoled. And if thou meetest any mortal, say: Lo! I have vowed a fast unto the Beneficent, and may not speak this day to any mortal

arabic: فَأَتَت بِهِ قَومَها تَحمِلُهُ قالوا يٰمَريَمُ لَقَد جِئتِ شَيـًٔا فَرِيًّا
transliteration: Faatat bihi qawmaha tahmiluhu qaloo ya maryamu laqad jiti shayan fariyyan
translation: Then she brought him to her own folk, carrying him. They said: O Mary! Thou hast come with an amazing thing

arabic: يٰأُختَ هٰرونَ ما كانَ أَبوكِ امرَأَ سَوءٍ وَما كانَت أُمُّكِ بَغِيًّا
transliteration: Ya okhta haroona ma kana abooki imraa sawin wama kanat ommuki baghiyyan
translation: O sister of Aaron! Thy father was not a wicked man nor was thy mother a harlot

arabic: فَأَشارَت إِلَيهِ قالوا كَيفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كانَ فِى المَهدِ صَبِيًّا
transliteration: Faasharat ilayhi qaloo kayfa nukallimu man kana fee almahdi sabiyyan
translation: Then she pointed to him. They said: How can we talk to one who is in the cradle, a young boy

arabic: قالَ إِنّى عَبدُ اللَّهِ ءاتىٰنِىَ الكِتٰبَ وَجَعَلَنى نَبِيًّا
transliteration: Qala innee AAabdu Allahi ataniya alkitaba wajaAAalanee nabiyyan
translation: He spake: Lo! I am the slave of Allah. He hath given me the Scripture and hath appointed me a Prophet

arabic: وَجَعَلَنى مُبارَكًا أَينَ ما كُنتُ وَأَوصٰنى بِالصَّلوٰةِ وَالزَّكوٰةِ ما دُمتُ حَيًّا
transliteration: WajaAAalanee mubarakan ayna ma kuntu waawsanee bialssalati waalzzakati ma dumtu hayyan
translation: And hath made me blessed wheresoever I may be, and hath enjoined upon me prayer and almsgiving so long as I remain alive

arabic: وَبَرًّا بِوٰلِدَتى وَلَم يَجعَلنى جَبّارًا شَقِيًّا
transliteration: Wabarran biwalidatee walam yajAAalnee jabbaran shaqiyyan
translation: And (hath made me) dutiful toward her who bore me, and hath not made me arrogant, unblest

arabic: وَالسَّلٰمُ عَلَىَّ يَومَ وُلِدتُ وَيَومَ أَموتُ وَيَومَ أُبعَثُ حَيًّا
transliteration: Waalssalamu AAalayya yawma wulidtu wayawma amootu wayawma obAAathu hayyan
translation: Peace on me the day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I shall be raised alive

arabic: ذٰلِكَ عيسَى ابنُ مَريَمَ قَولَ الحَقِّ الَّذى فيهِ يَمتَرونَ
transliteration: Thalika AAeesa ibnu maryama qawla alhaqqi allathee feehi yamtaroona
translation: Such was Jesus, son of Mary: (this is) a statement of the truth concerning which they doubt

arabic: ما كانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدٍ سُبحٰنَهُ إِذا قَضىٰ أَمرًا فَإِنَّما يَقولُ لَهُ كُن فَيَكونُ
transliteration: Ma kana lillahi an yattakhitha min waladin subhanahu itha qada amran fainnama yaqoolu lahu kun fayakoonu
translation: It befitteth not (the Majesty of) Allah that He should take unto Himself a son. Glory be to Him! When He decreeth a thing, He saith unto it only: Be! and it is

arabic: وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ رَبّى وَرَبُّكُم فَاعبُدوهُ هٰذا صِرٰطٌ مُستَقيمٌ
transliteration: Wainna Allaha rabbee warabbukum faoAAbudoohu hatha siratun mustaqeemun
translation: And lo! Allah is my Lord and your Lord. So serve Him. That is the right path

arabic: فَاختَلَفَ الأَحزابُ مِن بَينِهِم فَوَيلٌ لِلَّذينَ كَفَروا مِن مَشهَدِ يَومٍ عَظيمٍ
transliteration: Faikhtalafa alahzabu min baynihim fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo min mashhadi yawmin AAatheemin
translation: The sects among them differ: but woe unto the disbelievers from the meeting of an awful Day

arabic: أَسمِع بِهِم وَأَبصِر يَومَ يَأتونَنا لٰكِنِ الظّٰلِمونَ اليَومَ فى ضَلٰلٍ مُبينٍ
transliteration: AsmiAA bihim waabsir yawma yatoonana lakini alththalimoona alyawma fee dalalin mubeenin
translation: See and hear them on the Day they come unto Us! yet the evil-doers are to-day in error manifest

arabic: وَأَنذِرهُم يَومَ الحَسرَةِ إِذ قُضِىَ الأَمرُ وَهُم فى غَفلَةٍ وَهُم لا يُؤمِنونَ
transliteration: Waanthirhum yawma alhasrati ith qudiya alamru wahum fee ghaflatin wahum la yuminoona
translation: And warn them of the Day of anguish when the case hath been decided. Now they are in a state of carelessness, and they believe not

arabic: إِنّا نَحنُ نَرِثُ الأَرضَ وَمَن عَلَيها وَإِلَينا يُرجَعونَ
transliteration: Inna nahnu narithu alarda waman AAalayha wailayna yurjaAAoona
translation: Lo! We, only We, inherit the earth and all who are thereon, and unto Us they are returned

arabic: وَاذكُر فِى الكِتٰبِ إِبرٰهيمَ إِنَّهُ كانَ صِدّيقًا نَبِيًّا
transliteration: Waothkur fee alkitabi ibraheema innahu kana siddeeqan nabiyyan
translation: And make mention (O Muhammad) in the Scripture of Abraham. Lo! he was a saint, a prophet

arabic: إِذ قالَ لِأَبيهِ يٰأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعبُدُ ما لا يَسمَعُ وَلا يُبصِرُ وَلا يُغنى عَنكَ شَيـًٔا
transliteration: Ith qala liabeehi ya abati lima taAAbudu ma la yasmaAAu wala yubsiru wala yughnee AAanka shayan
translation: When he said unto his father: O my father! Why worshippest thou that which heareth not nor seeth, nor can in aught avail thee

arabic: يٰأَبَتِ إِنّى قَد جاءَنى مِنَ العِلمِ ما لَم يَأتِكَ فَاتَّبِعنى أَهدِكَ صِرٰطًا سَوِيًّا
transliteration: Ya abati innee qad jaanee mina alAAilmi ma lam yatika faittabiAAnee ahdika siratan sawiyyan
translation: O my father! Lo! there hath come unto me of knowledge that which came not unto thee. So follow me, and I will lead thee on a right path

arabic: يٰأَبَتِ لا تَعبُدِ الشَّيطٰنَ إِنَّ الشَّيطٰنَ كانَ لِلرَّحمٰنِ عَصِيًّا
transliteration: Ya abati la taAAbudi alshshaytana inna alshshaytana kana lilrrahmani AAasiyyan
translation: O my father! Serve not the devil. Lo! the devil is a rebel unto the Beneficent

arabic: يٰأَبَتِ إِنّى أَخافُ أَن يَمَسَّكَ عَذابٌ مِنَ الرَّحمٰنِ فَتَكونَ لِلشَّيطٰنِ وَلِيًّا
transliteration: Ya abati innee akhafu an yamassaka AAathabun mina alrrahmani fatakoona lilshshyatani waliyyan
translation: O my father! Lo! I fear lest a punishment from the Beneficent overtake thee so that thou become a comrade of the devil

arabic: قالَ أَراغِبٌ أَنتَ عَن ءالِهَتى يٰإِبرٰهيمُ لَئِن لَم تَنتَهِ لَأَرجُمَنَّكَ وَاهجُرنى مَلِيًّا
transliteration: Qala araghibun anta AAan alihatee ya ibraheemu lain lam tantahi laarjumannaka waohjurnee maliyyan
translation: He said: Rejectest thou my gods, O Abraham? If thou cease not, I shall surely stone thee. Depart from me a long while

arabic: قالَ سَلٰمٌ عَلَيكَ سَأَستَغفِرُ لَكَ رَبّى إِنَّهُ كانَ بى حَفِيًّا
transliteration: Qala salamun AAalayka saastaghfiru laka rabbee innahu kana bee hafiyyan
translation: He said: Peace be unto thee! I shall ask forgiveness of my Lord for thee. Lo! He was ever gracious unto me

arabic: وَأَعتَزِلُكُم وَما تَدعونَ مِن دونِ اللَّهِ وَأَدعوا رَبّى عَسىٰ أَلّا أَكونَ بِدُعاءِ رَبّى شَقِيًّا
transliteration: WaaAAtazilukum wama tadAAoona min dooni Allahi waadAAoo rabbee AAasa alla akoona biduAAai rabbee shaqiyyan
translation: I shall withdraw from you and that unto which ye pray beside Allah, and I shall pray unto my Lord. It may be that, in prayer unto my Lord, I shall not be unblest

arabic: فَلَمَّا اعتَزَلَهُم وَما يَعبُدونَ مِن دونِ اللَّهِ وَهَبنا لَهُ إِسحٰقَ وَيَعقوبَ وَكُلًّا جَعَلنا نَبِيًّا
transliteration: Falamma iAAtazalahum wama yaAAbudoona min dooni Allahi wahabna lahu ishaqa wayaAAqooba wakullan jaAAalna nabiyyan
translation: So, when he had withdrawn from them and that which they were worshipping beside Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob. Each of them We made a prophet

arabic: وَوَهَبنا لَهُم مِن رَحمَتِنا وَجَعَلنا لَهُم لِسانَ صِدقٍ عَلِيًّا
transliteration: Wawahabna lahum min rahmatina wajaAAalna lahum lisana sidqin AAaliyyan
translation: And we gave them of Our mercy, and assigned to them a high and true renown

arabic: وَاذكُر فِى الكِتٰبِ موسىٰ إِنَّهُ كانَ مُخلَصًا وَكانَ رَسولًا نَبِيًّا
transliteration: Waothkur fee alkitabi moosa innahu kana mukhlasan wakana rasoolan nabiyyan
translation: And make mention in the Scripture of Moses. Lo! he was chosen, and he was a messenger (of Allah), a prophet

arabic: وَنٰدَينٰهُ مِن جانِبِ الطّورِ الأَيمَنِ وَقَرَّبنٰهُ نَجِيًّا
transliteration: Wanadaynahu min janibi alttoori alaymani waqarrabnahu najiyyan
translation: We called him from the right slope of the Mount, and brought him nigh in communion

arabic: وَوَهَبنا لَهُ مِن رَحمَتِنا أَخاهُ هٰرونَ نَبِيًّا
transliteration: Wawahabna lahu min rahmatina akhahu haroona nabiyyan
translation: And We bestowed upon him of Our mercy his brother Aaron, a prophet (likewise)

arabic: وَاذكُر فِى الكِتٰبِ إِسمٰعيلَ إِنَّهُ كانَ صادِقَ الوَعدِ وَكانَ رَسولًا نَبِيًّا
transliteration: Waothkur fee alkitabi ismaAAeela innahu kana sadiqa alwaAAdi wakana rasoolan nabiyyan
translation: And make mention in the Scripture of Ishmael. Lo! he was a keeper of his promise, and he was a messenger (of Allah), a prophet

arabic: وَكانَ يَأمُرُ أَهلَهُ بِالصَّلوٰةِ وَالزَّكوٰةِ وَكانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِ مَرضِيًّا
transliteration: Wakana yamuru ahlahu bialssalati waalzzakati wakana AAinda rabbihi mardiyyan
translation: He enjoined upon his people worship and almsgiving, and was acceptable in the sight of his Lord

arabic: وَاذكُر فِى الكِتٰبِ إِدريسَ إِنَّهُ كانَ صِدّيقًا نَبِيًّا
transliteration: Waothkur fee alkitabi idreesa innahu kana siddeeqan nabiyyan
translation: And make mention in the Scripture of Idris. Lo! he was a saint, a prophet

arabic: وَرَفَعنٰهُ مَكانًا عَلِيًّا
transliteration: WarafaAAnahu makanan AAaliyyan
translation: And We raised him to high station

arabic: أُولٰئِكَ الَّذينَ أَنعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيهِم مِنَ النَّبِيّۦنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءادَمَ وَمِمَّن حَمَلنا مَعَ نوحٍ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبرٰهيمَ وَإِسرٰءيلَ وَمِمَّن هَدَينا وَاجتَبَينا إِذا تُتلىٰ عَلَيهِم ءايٰتُ الرَّحمٰنِ خَرّوا سُجَّدًا وَبُكِيًّا
transliteration: Olaika allatheena anAAama Allahu AAalayhim mina alnnabiyyeena min thurriyyati adama wamimman hamalna maAAa noohin wamin thurriyyati ibraheema waisraeela wamimman hadayna waijtabayna itha tutla AAalayhim ayatu alrrahmani kharroo sujjadan wabukiyyan
translation: These are they unto whom Allah showed favour from among the prophets, of the seed of Adam and of those whom We carried (in the ship) with Noah, and of the seed of Abraham and Israel, and from among those whom We guided and chose. When the revelations of the Beneficent were recited unto them, they fell down, adoring and weeping

arabic: فَخَلَفَ مِن بَعدِهِم خَلفٌ أَضاعُوا الصَّلوٰةَ وَاتَّبَعُوا الشَّهَوٰتِ فَسَوفَ يَلقَونَ غَيًّا
transliteration: Fakhalafa min baAAdihim khalfun adaAAoo alssalata waittabaAAoo alshshahawati fasawfa yalqawna ghayyan
translation: Now there hath succeeded them a later generation whom have ruined worship and have followed lusts. But they will meet deception

arabic: إِلّا مَن تابَ وَءامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صٰلِحًا فَأُولٰئِكَ يَدخُلونَ الجَنَّةَ وَلا يُظلَمونَ شَيـًٔا
transliteration: Illa man taba waamana waAAamila salihan faolaika yadkhuloona aljannata wala yuthlamoona shayan
translation: Save him who shall repent and believe and do right. Such will enter the Garden, and they will not be wronged in aught

arabic: جَنّٰتِ عَدنٍ الَّتى وَعَدَ الرَّحمٰنُ عِبادَهُ بِالغَيبِ إِنَّهُ كانَ وَعدُهُ مَأتِيًّا
transliteration: Jannati AAadnin allatee waAAada alrrahmanu AAibadahu bialghaybi innahu kana waAAduhu matiyyan
translation: Gardens of Eden, which the Beneficent hath promised to His slaves in the unseen. Lo! His promise is ever sure of fulfilment

arabic: لا يَسمَعونَ فيها لَغوًا إِلّا سَلٰمًا وَلَهُم رِزقُهُم فيها بُكرَةً وَعَشِيًّا
transliteration: La yasmaAAoona feeha laghwan illa salaman walahum rizquhum feeha bukratan waAAashiyyan
translation: They hear therein no idle talk, but only Peace; and therein they have food for morn and evening

arabic: تِلكَ الجَنَّةُ الَّتى نورِثُ مِن عِبادِنا مَن كانَ تَقِيًّا
transliteration: Tilka aljannatu allatee noorithu min AAibadina man kana taqiyyan
translation: Such is the Garden which We cause the devout among Our bondmen to inherit

arabic: وَما نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلّا بِأَمرِ رَبِّكَ لَهُ ما بَينَ أَيدينا وَما خَلفَنا وَما بَينَ ذٰلِكَ وَما كانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّا
transliteration: Wama natanazzalu illa biamri rabbika lahu ma bayna aydeena wama khalfana wama bayna thalika wama kana rabbuka nasiyyan
translation: We (angels) come not down save by commandment of thy Lord. Unto Him belongeth all that is before us and all that is behind us and all that is between those two, and thy Lord was never forgetful

arabic: رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَما بَينَهُما فَاعبُدهُ وَاصطَبِر لِعِبٰدَتِهِ هَل تَعلَمُ لَهُ سَمِيًّا
transliteration: Rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma faoAAbudhu waistabir liAAibadatihi hal taAAlamu lahu samiyyan
translation: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them! Therefor, worship thou Him and be thou steadfast in His service. Knowest thou one that can be named along with Him

arabic: وَيَقولُ الإِنسٰنُ أَءِذا ما مِتُّ لَسَوفَ أُخرَجُ حَيًّا
transliteration: Wayaqoolu alinsanu aitha ma mittu lasawfa okhraju hayyan
translation: And man saith: When I am dead, shall I forsooth be brought forth alive

arabic: أَوَلا يَذكُرُ الإِنسٰنُ أَنّا خَلَقنٰهُ مِن قَبلُ وَلَم يَكُ شَيـًٔا
transliteration: Awala yathkuru alinsanu anna khalaqnahu min qablu walam yaku shayan
translation: Doth not man remember that We created him before, when he was naught

arabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحشُرَنَّهُم وَالشَّيٰطينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحضِرَنَّهُم حَولَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّا
transliteration: Fawarabbika lanahshurannahum waalshshayateena thumma lanuhdirannahum hawla jahannama jithiyyan
translation: And, by thy Lord, verily We shall assemble them and the devils, then We shall bring them, crouching, around hell

arabic: ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شيعَةٍ أَيُّهُم أَشَدُّ عَلَى الرَّحمٰنِ عِتِيًّا
transliteration: Thumma lananziAAanna min kulli sheeAAatin ayyuhum ashaddu AAala alrrahmani AAitiyyan
translation: Then We shall pluck out from every sect whichever of them was most stubborn in rebellion to the Beneficent

arabic: ثُمَّ لَنَحنُ أَعلَمُ بِالَّذينَ هُم أَولىٰ بِها صِلِيًّا
transliteration: Thumma lanahnu aAAlamu biallatheena hum awla biha siliyyan
translation: And surely We are Best Aware of those most worthy to be burned therein

arabic: وَإِن مِنكُم إِلّا وارِدُها كانَ عَلىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتمًا مَقضِيًّا
transliteration: Wain minkum illa wariduha kana AAala rabbika hatman maqdiyyan
translation: There is not one of you but shall approach it. That is a fixed ordinance of thy Lord

arabic: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى الَّذينَ اتَّقَوا وَنَذَرُ الظّٰلِمينَ فيها جِثِيًّا
transliteration: Thumma nunajjee allatheena ittaqaw wanatharu alththalimeena feeha jithiyyan
translation: Then We shall rescue those who kept from evil, and leave the evil-doers crouching there

arabic: وَإِذا تُتلىٰ عَلَيهِم ءايٰتُنا بَيِّنٰتٍ قالَ الَّذينَ كَفَروا لِلَّذينَ ءامَنوا أَىُّ الفَريقَينِ خَيرٌ مَقامًا وَأَحسَنُ نَدِيًّا
transliteration: Waitha tutla AAalayhim ayatuna bayyinatin qala allatheena kafaroo lillatheena amanoo ayyu alfareeqayni khayrun maqaman waahsanu nadiyyan
translation: And when Our clear revelations are recited unto them, those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Which of the two parties (yours or ours) is better in position, and more imposing as an army

arabic: وَكَم أَهلَكنا قَبلَهُم مِن قَرنٍ هُم أَحسَنُ أَثٰثًا وَرِءيًا
transliteration: Wakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hum ahsanu athathan wariyan
translation: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, who were more imposing in respect of gear and outward seeming

arabic: قُل مَن كانَ فِى الضَّلٰلَةِ فَليَمدُد لَهُ الرَّحمٰنُ مَدًّا حَتّىٰ إِذا رَأَوا ما يوعَدونَ إِمَّا العَذابَ وَإِمَّا السّاعَةَ فَسَيَعلَمونَ مَن هُوَ شَرٌّ مَكانًا وَأَضعَفُ جُندًا
transliteration: Qul man kana fee alddalalati falyamdud lahu alrrahmanu maddan hatta itha raaw ma yooAAadoona imma alAAathaba waimma alssaAAata fasayaAAlamoona man huwa sharrun makanan waadAAafu jundan
translation: Say: As for him who is in error, the Beneficent will verily prolong his span of life until, when they behold that which they were promised, whether it be punishment (in the world), or the Hour (of doom), they will know who is worse in position and who is weaker as an army

arabic: وَيَزيدُ اللَّهُ الَّذينَ اهتَدَوا هُدًى وَالبٰقِيٰتُ الصّٰلِحٰتُ خَيرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوابًا وَخَيرٌ مَرَدًّا
transliteration: Wayazeedu Allahu allatheena ihtadaw hudan waalbaqiyatu alssalihatu khayrun AAinda rabbika thawaban wakhayrun maraddan
translation: Allah increaseth in right guidance those who walk aright, and the good deeds which endure are better in thy Lord's sight for reward, and better for resort

arabic: أَفَرَءَيتَ الَّذى كَفَرَ بِـٔايٰتِنا وَقالَ لَأوتَيَنَّ مالًا وَوَلَدًا
transliteration: Afaraayta allathee kafara biayatina waqala laootayanna malan wawaladan
translation: Hast thou seen him who disbelieveth in Our revelations and saith: Assuredly I shall be given wealth and children

arabic: أَطَّلَعَ الغَيبَ أَمِ اتَّخَذَ عِندَ الرَّحمٰنِ عَهدًا
transliteration: AttalaAAa alghayba ami ittakhatha AAinda alrrahmani AAahdan
translation: Hath he perused the Unseen, or hath he made a pact with the Beneficent

arabic: كَلّا سَنَكتُبُ ما يَقولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُ مِنَ العَذابِ مَدًّا
transliteration: Kalla sanaktubu ma yaqoolu wanamuddu lahu mina alAAathabi maddan
translation: Nay, but We shall record that which he saith and prolong for him a span of torment

arabic: وَنَرِثُهُ ما يَقولُ وَيَأتينا فَردًا
transliteration: Wanarithuhu ma yaqoolu wayateena fardan
translation: And We shall inherit from him that whereof he spake, and he will come unto Us, alone (without his wealth and children)

arabic: وَاتَّخَذوا مِن دونِ اللَّهِ ءالِهَةً لِيَكونوا لَهُم عِزًّا
transliteration: Waittakhathoo min dooni Allahi alihatan liyakoonoo lahum AAizzan
translation: And they have chosen (other) gods beside Allah that they may be a power for them

arabic: كَلّا سَيَكفُرونَ بِعِبادَتِهِم وَيَكونونَ عَلَيهِم ضِدًّا
transliteration: Kalla sayakfuroona biAAibadatihim wayakoonoona AAalayhim diddan
translation: Nay, but they will deny their worship of them, and become opponents unto them

arabic: أَلَم تَرَ أَنّا أَرسَلنَا الشَّيٰطينَ عَلَى الكٰفِرينَ تَؤُزُّهُم أَزًّا
transliteration: Alam tara anna arsalna alshshayateena AAala alkafireena taozzuhum azzan
translation: Seest thou not that We have set the devils on the disbelievers to confound them with confusion

arabic: فَلا تَعجَل عَلَيهِم إِنَّما نَعُدُّ لَهُم عَدًّا
transliteration: Fala taAAjal AAalayhim innama naAAuddu lahum AAaddan
translation: So make no haste against them (O Muhammad). We do but number unto them a sum (of days)

arabic: يَومَ نَحشُرُ المُتَّقينَ إِلَى الرَّحمٰنِ وَفدًا
transliteration: Yawma nahshuru almuttaqeena ila alrrahmani wafdan
translation: On the day when We shall gather the righteous unto the Beneficent, a goodly company

arabic: وَنَسوقُ المُجرِمينَ إِلىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِردًا
transliteration: Wanasooqu almujrimeena ila jahannama wirdan
translation: And drive the guilty unto hell, a weary herd

arabic: لا يَملِكونَ الشَّفٰعَةَ إِلّا مَنِ اتَّخَذَ عِندَ الرَّحمٰنِ عَهدًا
transliteration: La yamlikoona alshshafaAAata illa mani ittakhatha AAinda alrrahmani AAahdan
translation: They will have no power of intercession, save him who hath made a covenant with his Lord

arabic: وَقالُوا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحمٰنُ وَلَدًا
transliteration: Waqaloo ittakhatha alrrahmanu waladan
translation: And they say: The Beneficent hath taken unto Himself a son

arabic: لَقَد جِئتُم شَيـًٔا إِدًّا
transliteration: Laqad jitum shayan iddan
translation: Assuredly ye utter a disastrous thing

arabic: تَكادُ السَّمٰوٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرنَ مِنهُ وَتَنشَقُّ الأَرضُ وَتَخِرُّ الجِبالُ هَدًّا
transliteration: Takadu alssamawatu yatafattarna minhu watanshaqqu alardu watakhirru aljibalu haddan
translation: Whereby almost the heavens are torn, and the earth is split asunder and the mountains fall in ruins

arabic: أَن دَعَوا لِلرَّحمٰنِ وَلَدًا
transliteration: An daAAaw lilrrahmani waladan
translation: That ye ascribe unto the Beneficent a son

arabic: وَما يَنبَغى لِلرَّحمٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا
transliteration: Wama yanbaghee lilrrahmani an yattakhitha waladan
translation: When it is not meet for (the Majesty of) the Beneficent that He should choose a son

arabic: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ إِلّا ءاتِى الرَّحمٰنِ عَبدًا
transliteration: In kullu man fee alssamawati waalardi illa atee alrrahmani AAabdan
translation: There is none in the heavens and the earth but cometh unto the Beneficent as a slave

arabic: لَقَد أَحصىٰهُم وَعَدَّهُم عَدًّا
transliteration: Laqad ahsahum waAAaddahum AAaddan
translation: Verily He knoweth them and numbereth them with (right) numbering

arabic: وَكُلُّهُم ءاتيهِ يَومَ القِيٰمَةِ فَردًا
transliteration: Wakulluhum ateehi yawma alqiyamati fardan
translation: And each one of them will come unto Him on the Day of Resurrection, alone

arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ سَيَجعَلُ لَهُمُ الرَّحمٰنُ وُدًّا
transliteration: Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati sayajAAalu lahumu alrrahmanu wuddan
translation: Lo! those who believe and do good works, the Beneficent will appoint for them love

arabic: فَإِنَّما يَسَّرنٰهُ بِلِسانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ المُتَّقينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِ قَومًا لُدًّا
transliteration: Fainnama yassarnahu bilisanika litubashshira bihi almuttaqeena watunthira bihi qawman luddan
translation: And We make (this Scripture) easy in thy tongue, (O Muhammad) only that thou mayst bear good tidings therewith unto those who ward off (evil), and warn therewith the froward folk

arabic: وَكَم أَهلَكنا قَبلَهُم مِن قَرنٍ هَل تُحِسُّ مِنهُم مِن أَحَدٍ أَو تَسمَعُ لَهُم رِكزًا
transliteration: Wakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hal tuhissu minhum min ahadin aw tasmaAAu lahum rikzan
translation: And how many a generation before them have We destroyed! Canst thou (Muhammad) see a single man of them, or hear from them the slightest sound
